name: app-check-recaptcha-providers-construct
description: firebase/app-check ReCaptchaV3Provider and ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider in a realm with global document: construct from a siteKey, return the AppCheck handle from initializeAppCheck, return the identical handle on a second call with equal options, and throw appCheck/already-initialized on a different siteKey or provider class.

thirdDifferentSiteKey.name: FirebaseError
thirdDifferentSiteKey.message: AppCheck: You have already called initializeAppCheck() for FirebaseApp <appName> with different options. To avoid this error, call initializeAppCheck() with the same options as when it was originally called. This will return the already initialized instance. (appCheck/already-initialized).
